featured_reviews.name: Het Bavalia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I Traveled all the way from Navsari, Gujarat to Ghatkopar just to visit this shoe shop, and overall I’d say it’s worth the trip if you’re looking for surplus shoes at a big discount. They mainly sell surplus stock of original‑quality shoes, though some pairs did feel like first‑copy to me — so you really need to be smart and inspect the build quality before buying.
I bought a running shoe from the Pegasus series for my sister, and it was clearly 100% original. You could see it in the stitching, material, and overall finish. I paid around ₹2,000 for it, while the same model was priced around ₹5,650 online, so the savings were very real. I’ve also shopped here before and bought a pair of Converse for myself, which turned out to be genuine as well.
The staff is a bit hit‑or‑miss — sometimes they help, sometimes they don’t, and the experience feels more like self‑service. When I went, the overall collection was somewhat limited; there was a good range in Crocs, but very few formal shoes. The store is located a bit inside, so it’s better to check the location properly before heading there.
One thing to note: they do not negotiate the price at all. However, if you don’t mind limited stock and fixed pricing, this is still a solid option. They even come to Surat for exhibitions during Diwali, so if you’re in Gujarat and want to buy there, keep an eye out for those events.

One more tip they have a section for minor faults kept at very cheap rates.Look out for that.
